forbiddenKeys.description: A key anywhere in a proposal is normalized, then refused when it equals an exact name or contains a stem. A key longer than maxKeyLength (Unicode code points of the key as received) or not printable ASCII after normalization cannot be checked and is refused too. A key whose value is a number is exempt (an evidence signal such as sessions: 3 cannot carry session content). String values outside the file-content fields that parse as a JSON object or array are checked as nested documents.
normalization: percent-decode %XX escapes until nothing changes (at most 3 rounds), each escape to the code unit of its byte
refuse when any character is outside printable ASCII (U+0020 to U+007E)

refusal.reports: the key path only, never the value

content.description: What a change introduces (added lines of a changed file, a new file whole, the evidence summary) is refused on any rule below; findings are danger:<rule>:<path> and never carry the matched text. Regular expressions are implementation detail; the vectors are the contract.
